title: test(types): measure the MIRRORED-but-undeclared direction the zod-mirror-parity ratchet was blind to (objectui#9711)
body:
Fixes #9711

Clause-②: no

The `zod-mirror-parity` ratchet could not see a key the **zod mirror declares** and the **TypeScript twin does not**. This PR delivers the **instrument** for that direction. It delivers no remediation, and that is deliberate: declaring any key the new direction reports, on a published TypeScript face, ENLARGES AN ACCEPT SET — a different card, at-tier.

## Why all three prior operators were blind, each for a different reason

Re-read at the head this branch was cut from, not inherited:

- `WithoutIndexSignature` strips `BaseSchema`'s string index signature, so a key the declaration never states has nothing to be stripped FROM — `DeclaredKeys` cannot enumerate it.
- `UnmirroredDeclaredKeys` is `Exclude< DeclaredKeys, MirroredKeys >`: declared-minus-mirrored, the other subtraction by construction.
- `WiderThanDeclaredKeys` maps over `MirroredKeys & DeclaredKeys` — the INTERSECTION — so such a key is outside its domain and LEAVES THE COMPARISON, the same shape objectui#6058 measured in the opposite direction.

## What landed

`MirroredUndeclaredKeys` plus the seeded `MirroredUndeclared` ledger, reconciled by `assertionMirroredUndeclaredMatchesLedger` (by pair) and `assertionMirroredUndeclaredRecordsEveryKey` (by key), with the same shrink-only ratchet the other three ledgers carry — growth on a clean pair and growth on a ledgered pair both redden, and a key that leaves the measurement reddens as stale.

`LedgerName` gains one union arm, so the new ledger is sized by the SAME AST reader as the other four rather than by a second definition of the word "key".

## The lit-control discipline, at operator granularity

⭐ ONE synthetic pair on which ALL FOUR operators fire, **each on a different key**, with the declaration carrying the real `[key: string]: any`:

| key | on which face | which operator reports it |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | both, in agreement | none — the control against a matcher that catches everything |
| `stray` | mirror only | `MirroredUndeclaredKeys` only |
| `missing` | declaration only | `UnmirroredDeclaredKeys` only |
| `wide` | both, mirror accepts more | `WiderThanDeclaredKeys` only |
| `narrow` | both, mirror accepts less | `NarrowerThanDeclared` only |

⇒ every "operator X is blind to `stray`" claim is a **zero read beside a lit control on the same instrument and the same corpus**, not a zero read alone. Resolved through the TypeScript compiler API before being written down, so the pins are a measurement rather than a prediction.

The naive spelling is pinned beside the working one: `Exclude< MirroredKeys, Extract< keyof D, string > >` reads `never` on that pair (the index signature absorbs it) and reads `stray` on the same pair with the index signature removed. So the `never` is the defect reproduced, not an operator that cannot report anything.

## What the new direction catches on today's tree, BY NAME

Derived with the compiler API over `tsconfig.test.json`, one binding per registered pair, walking each union's string-literal members — ⛔ never read off a compile error, for the truncation reason this file's own header records.

**8 entries carrying 102 keys**, out of the 161 registered pairs. ⛔ Read those two figures off the census, not off this sentence: the ledger docstring is the one place a human writes them and the test `the fourth direction is enumerated and sized at test time` derives both from the ledger's own AST.

| `app.zod.ts#AppComponentSchema` | SPEC-DERIVED | 20 | `contextSelectors` `_lock` `_lockReason` `_lockSource` `_provenance` `_packageId` `_packageVersion` `_lockDocsUrl` `version` `isDefault` `_unpublished` `homePageId` `objects` `apis` `sharing` `embed` `mobileNavigation` `defaultAgent` `aria` `protection` |
| `complex.zod.ts#DashboardComponentSchema` | SPEC-DERIVED | 11 | `_lock` `_lockReason` `_lockSource` `_provenance` `_packageId` `_packageVersion` `_lockDocsUrl` `aria` `protection` `refreshInterval` `performance` |
| `complex.zod.ts#DashboardConfigSchema` | LOCAL | 1 | `aria` |
| `form.zod.ts#InputShorthandSchema` | LOCAL | 32 | `label` `error` `description` `id` `name` `pattern` `placeholder` `className` `style` `data` `bind` `body` `children` `visible` `visibleWhen` `visibleOn` `hidden` `hiddenOn` `disabled` `disabledOn` `testId` `defaultValue` `ariaLabel` `required` `value` `min` `max` `step` `onChange` `wrapperClass` `readOnly` `maxLength` |
| `form.zod.ts#UiCalendarSchema` | LOCAL | 26 | `label` `description` `id` `name` `placeholder` `className` `style` `data` `bind` `body` `children` `visible` `visibleWhen` `visibleOn` `hidden` `hiddenOn` `disabled` `disabledOn` `testId` `defaultValue` `ariaLabel` `value` `onChange` `mode` `minDate` `maxDate` |
| `layout.zod.ts#PageNodeSchema` | SPEC-DERIVED | 10 | `source` `_lock` `_lockReason` `_lockSource` `_provenance` `_packageId` `_packageVersion` `_lockDocsUrl` `interfaceConfig` `requires` |
| `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectGridSchema` | SPEC-DERIVED | 1 | `operators` |
| `views.zod.ts#DetailViewFieldSchema` | LOCAL | 1 | `dueLike` |

Non-vacuity of that reading: **153 of 161 pairs read EMPTY**, so the walker is discriminating rather than uniformly silent. Lit control on the same instrument and the same corpus: the existing `UnmirroredOf` direction read 14 pairs / 93 keys in the same pass.

Two classes, stated as a reading and not as a rule the instrument applies:

- **SPEC-OWNED INFLOW** — the mirror is built `.extend(SpecXFields.shape)`, so the spec surface flows in by reference while the hand-written interface restates only the subset the renderers read.
- **`Omit` COLLAPSE** — the declaration is `Omit< Base, K >` over an interface carrying the index signature, so `Exclude< keyof Base, K >` resolves through `string` and every member collapses into the signature. That face has never declared the keys its docblock describes. ⚠️ This is already documented in `packages/types/src/form.ts` for the calendar twin and pinned by `content-channel-family-d-9256.test.ts` — the new operator rediscovers it independently, which is evidence the operator reads the published face and not a convenient subset.

⭐ `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectGridSchema.operators` is this card's thesis in one key: the mirror carries a comment saying the key was missing from an earlier TypeScript scan. The gap was noticed at authoring time, written into a comment, and then measured by nothing until this direction existed.

## Ablation — both legs, mutation proven on disk BEFORE any result was read

Both legs ran from the committed implementation, under `trap RESTORE_FN EXIT INT TERM` with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`.

**Leg A — GROWTH: a fresh mirrored-but-undeclared key on a CLEAN pair.** Added `ablationProbe9711: z.string().optional()` to `overlay.zod.ts#TooltipSchema`.

```
BEFORE: blob=e70bde566c3e5172a3723c50d59b6febc8f93387 bytes=31888 anchor_count=1 marker_count=0
AFTER : blob=86a1e2b3551271898cd477ec24e578ef8769ee9d bytes=32017 marker_count=1
BYTE_DELTA=129   (blob differs from the HEAD blob; anchor and marker counts moved as predicted)
MUTATION PROVEN ON DISK
ABLATION_A_TSC_EXIT=2
  error TS2322: Type '"overlay.zod.ts#TooltipSchema"' is not assignable to type 'never'.
  error TS2322: Type '"ablationProbe9711"' is not assignable to type 'never'.
RESTORED: blob=e70bde566c3e5172a3723c50d59b6febc8f93387   GIT_DIFF_HEAD_LINES=0
```

⇒ the guard fires, names the **pair** and the **key**, and reports **exactly those two** — no other assertion moved, so the output is precise and not a blanket failure.

**Leg B — the operator is what catches it.** Same growth key, plus `DeclaredKeys< D >` swapped for the naive `Extract< keyof D, string >` in the operator. Two files mutated, both proven on disk (mirror blob `e70bde56` to `86a1e2b3`, +129 bytes; guard blob `ee6b2bf2` to `97f42190`, +9 bytes; `DeclaredKeys` spelling 1 to 0, naive spelling 0 to 1).

```
ABLATION_B_TSC_EXIT=2   ABLATION_B_ERROR_COUNT=3
GROWTH_KEY_NAMED=0   GROWTH_PAIR_NAMED=0
  error TS2344: Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'.            (the synthetic recognition pin)
  error TS2322: Type '"app.zod.ts#AppComponentSchema" | ... | "objectql.zod.ts#ObjectGridSchema"' is not assignable to type 'never'.
  error TS2322: Type 'MirroredUndeclaredLedgerKeyDrift' is not assignable to type 'never'.
RESTORED mirror blob=e70bde56…  guard blob=ee6b2bf2…   GIT_DIFF_HEAD_LINES=0
```

⇒ under the naive spelling the growth key and its pair are **not named** — a **measured absence**, because the very same run is red and IS naming seven other pairs plus the synthetic pin. The zero has its lit control inside the same output.

⭐ Seven of the eight seeded pairs go stale under the naive spelling, not eight. The eighth is `views.zod.ts#DetailViewFieldSchema`, whose declaration does **not** extend `BaseSchema` and therefore carries no index signature for the naive spelling to be absorbed by — so it still reads `dueLike`. The mechanism is confirmed at exactly the granularity claimed: the blindness is the index signature, nothing else.

⛔ No ablation artefact is left in the tree. Both legs restored to blob equality with the HEAD blob and to an empty `git diff HEAD`, proven by observing state — never by reading a cleanup step's exit code.

## Gates — exit code captured to a variable BEFORE any pipe, in every case

| gate | exit | verdict line |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` | 0 | all three legs, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` included |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types test` | 0 | `Test Files 202 passed (202)` · `Tests 4703 passed (4703)` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | every changeset has an EMPTY frontmatter — declared as releasing nothing |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | `check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 7818 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)` |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)` |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 | report-only; see the reading below |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test …` | 0 | `NOT GOVERNED — 2 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched` |

Additionally derived from the changed paths and run: `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0, `check:test-path-roots` 0, `check:unreferenced-sources` 0.

The heavy runs went through the shared verify lock; each printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

**`check:changeset-claims` reading.** It reports 10 pending changesets whose bodies name `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` and asks the editing seat to re-read them. Read: this PR adds a NEW ledger and moves **no entry and no key** in `KnownDrift`, `UnmirroredDeclared`, `RuntimeOnlyDeclared` or `WiderThanDeclared`, which is what every one of those paragraphs describes. ⇒ none of them is falsified. Report-only, exit 0.

**Lint, declared narrowing.** This repo's `lint` is `turbo run lint` — per-package `eslint .`, not one root run. The only package this diff touches is `@object-ui/types`, and its **complete** package lint ran: exit 0, 0 errors. So there is no narrowing at the package level. `eslint.config.js` configures **no** `project` / `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch. Whole-repo `eslint . --no-inline-config` belongs to CI.

⚠️ Declared, because it is a real delta: the diff adds **one** `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` **warning** (base file: 1 warning, 0 errors; this file: 2 warnings, 0 errors). The `any` is `[key: string]: any` on the synthetic declaration and it is load-bearing — it reproduces `BaseSchema`'s exact index signature, which is the whole subject of the pin. With `unknown` there, `NarrowerThanDeclared` would report `stray` and the four-way separation would be destroyed. It carries an inline disable that the package lint honours and that the repo-wide `--no-inline-config` run ignores by design.

## Scope

⛔ No declaration moved. ⛔ No mirror moved. ⛔ No ledger entry outside the new one moved. One test file, plus an empty-frontmatter changeset: `packages/types/package.json` publishes `dist` only and `tsconfig.json` excludes `*.test.ts` from the build, so no published byte moves.

File surface held to: `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` and `.changeset/9711-zod-mirror-parity-mirrored-undeclared.md`. No file on any in-flight PR of this lane was reached.

## The honest end state

The new direction catches keys this card may not fix. That is the stated correct outcome: they are listed above by name, seeded as a FLOOR that can only shrink, and each remedy — declaring the key, or narrowing the mirror — is a published-accept-set decision belonging to its own card and its own review.
